findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report | 26 November 2026
findings.publisher: United Nations OCHA occupied Palestinian territory
findings.source_type: Official UN situation report, attributed sector data
findings.location: Sheikh Radwan Lagoon, Gaza City; Gaza Strip stormwater network
findings.affected_population_system: Stormwater pumping station operates below 40% of design capacity; approximately 4,000 stormwater manholes lack covers, increasing blockage and sewage overflow risk during rain. This quantifies impaired infrastructure beyond the previously logged municipal flood warning.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: operating at less than 40 per cent of its design capacity

bounded_discovery_context.method: Full OCHA report, essential services section; compared with 28 authenticated prior watch files.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Previously unrecorded specific pumping capacity and uncovered manhole estimate, not a repeat of generic flood warning.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Reporting period November 17–23; measurement date and actual future flooding unknown.

findings.title: Gaza: Basic winter survival items out of reach for families
findings.publisher: Norwegian Refugee Council / Palestine Shelter Cluster
findings.affected_population_system: Shelter access: winter essentials for six people estimated at USD 6,171 locally versus USD 716 internationally with humanitarian transport. Only 35% of approximately USD 283 million minimum winter response funded; fewer than 6,500 tents in stock as of November 15; stocks and pipeline cover under 20% of blankets, mattresses and solar light needs and under 1% of winter clothing needs. Shelter Cluster also reports rejection of materials sufficient for at least 11,700 shelter kits; date of rejection unknown.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: donors have provided just 35 per cent of the USD 283 million required
findings.source_type: Primary humanitarian organization press release citing cluster data

bounded_discovery_context.method: Followed official NRC release linked in OCHA November 26 report and read full statement including notes; compared with 28 authenticated prior watch files.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Distinct quantified affordability, supply and funding constraints; earlier publication recovered this run, not the municipal warning already logged.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Publication hour unknown; no evidence these changes occurred in past hour; not independently audited.
